_note: One file per candidate: hiring/out/verification/<slug>.json. Claude fills it, claim_check.py renders it. Statuses: Verified, Unverified, Clarification needed. Sources: the candidate's own documents, a source they supplied, or one public company page. A result that may not be this person is not used and not written here.
purpose: Check only the job claims the user named: the dates at [Company] and the brand she says she ran.

not_checked: Every claim the user did not name
Internal numbers (sales, stock, time saved): not public; they are questions for the call
Criminal record, credit and degree checks: they need consent and a licensed service, and are not part of this step
not_looked_at: Family, relationships, religion, health, politics, age, origin, appearance, personal social media. No search on the person's name.
